title: The Distant Machine
author: Freya Okonkwo
blurb: Theo Ishikawa, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
